chapter: Reel IV retellings and New York pianists
title: Directing for the Nicholas Brothers in Philadelphia
summary: Whaley retells how he was told to direct the band for the Nicholas Brothers before he had ever directed.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Now the Nicholas Brothers -- they came after them, but I was directing a band over in Philadelphia, see, and the man comes to me and says -- no, I was playing piano, I also played piano, and he asked me why didn't I direct the band and let this woman -- and he was talking about Mrs. Nicholas, she was playing piano and her husband was a drummer.
So he says why don't you direct and let her play? And I said, 'Oh, I can't direct' --and this was before
So finally, I said okay, and I directed the show and she'd play and her husband was the drummer, and the Nicholas Brothers were in the show. And they were terrific.
Nicholas Brothers? Let's see, I can't recall their names right now.
Anyway, they're still going great yet.
